test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Puthumana Govindan Namboothiri, chief revivalist and exponent of ______ received the Kerala State Award by Kerala Folklore Academy on 7 December 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is " Thindabu Nritham"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** **Puthumana Govindan Namboothiri won the Kerala State Award by Kerala Folklore Academy in December 2021**.

__
 
• He has **developed Thidambu Nritham as a classical dance** form in Malabar region.
 
• This Dance is performed in** Goa and Karnataka.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__

__
 
• Thidambu Nritham is a **ritual dance performed in North Malabar region** of South India.
 
• Mainly it is performed by** Nambothiries **and some othe** Brahmin.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Charkula Dance**

 
 
• Charkula Dance is a classical dance form performed in the **Braj region of Uttar Pradesh.**
 
• This Dance is performed just** after 3 days of Holi.**
 
• It is believed that **Radha was born on this day**
 
 
 
• **Ghode modini**
 
 
• Ghode Modini Dance is **performed in Goa**
 
• This is performed the** remembrance victory of the Maratha ruler **over Goa
 
 
 
• **Kummi Dance**
 
 
• ​ Kummi Dance is performed in Kerala and Tamil Nadu
 
• This is performed by the women in a circle with clapping
